verdict.rationale: Dropbox has a native e-signature product, Dropbox Sign. Its docs say users can send signature requests from Dropbox and sign documents without leaving Dropbox, signed documents save back to storage, and plans include 'Edit PDFs and get signatures'. A first-party eSignature API documents a Send Signature Request operation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-Dropbox signing workflow, and deeper documentation of signing features such as templates or audit trails beyond marketing snippets.

support.subject: As an operations lead, signatures happen where the files live — a native e-signature product or documented first-party signing integration

citations.quote: Send signature requests from Dropbox or other everyday tools, with fewer manual steps along the way.
Store your content, Edit PDFs, share videos, sign documents—without leaving Dropbox.
Automatically save signed documents to your preferred storage account.
